featured_reviews.name: Parth Anjaria
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am deeply disappointed and hurt by the misinformation given to us at the counter, especially when it is in the name of religion and daan. This kind of miscommunication shakes people’s faith in the system and the sanctity of the process.
We had specifically asked about offering lapsi to the cows. While issuing the receipt, we were told to come at 6:30 AM for darshan because no one is allowed inside while the lapsi is being fed. We respected this rule, understanding that every place has its own traditions and protocols.
However, when my parents went in the morning, they were told that lapsi would be given according to the Haveli’s time. Later, when I personally went to clarify, the staff informed me that darshan is not allowed during lapsi seva at all, as the feeding happens at midnight (around 2:30–4:00 AM depending on their routine), and that receipts are not even issued for lapsi.
This raises two very concerning questions:
Why were we asked to come at 6:30 AM for darshan in the first place?
Why was this clearly not explained at the time of issuing the receipt?
This is not about money at all.
It is about the incorrect and misleading information provided at the counter.
The Haveli itself is truly divine and inspiring, but such mismanagement and misinformation can deeply hurt devotees and slowly erode the faith of an entire generation.
I hope the management takes this feedback seriously and ensures that accurate information is given to devotees in the future, so no one leaves with hurt sentiments.
Jai Shree Krishna 🙏
